title: How the region fits together, and where your piece plugs in
dek: One map of how The Upskilling Labs of Greater Washington runs today, what’s planned, and four places where value leaks. For the core contributors who will fix them.
cover_alt: A map of the region: boxes for national, the steering committee, sessions, the Build Cycle, practitioners and people at each stage, with lines for people, work and code, knowledge, and money and support, red lines where people leave, and one open ring where alumni carry a skill and a record out.
